title: Adversarial Security Capstone: Audit, Attack & Fortify
summary: Audit an enterprise AI agent, execute multi-vector adversarial attacks, implement multi-layered defenses, and verify zero exploit pass rate.
objectives: Perform a full black-box and white-box security audit of an AI agent.
Demonstrate successful exploitation across prompt injection and insecure output channels.
Fortify the architecture and prove 100% defense validation across regression suites.

sections.title: Security Capstone Audit Standard
paragraphs: In this capstone, you will audit a vulnerable enterprise agent, uncover injection and data exfiltration flaws, build multi-layered defense guardrails, and generate an executive penetration testing report.

activity.title: Deliver Fortified Agent Security Package
instructions: Execute 20 attack vectors and document proof-of-concept exploits.
Implement defense guardrails and verify zero successful exploit rate.
evidence: Security audit report, exploit PoCs, fortification patch diff, and verification logs.
activity.reflectionPrompt: How do you balance aggressive security filtering with user experience and false-positive rejections?

questions.prompt: What architectural design principle prevents a successfully injected prompt from executing destructive backend actions?
choices: Strict principle of least privilege, scoped tool contracts, and explicit human authorization checkpoints.
Increasing the model maximum context window length.
Converting all text data to PDF format.
Running the model on an unmetered cloud subscription.
questions.explanation: Layered defense with least privilege tool scoping and human-in-the-loop authorization prevents model intent hijacking from causing real-world damage.
